A [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] capable of releasing a deadly virus to [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. By the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] it had been buried on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. After learning of the existence of the weapon, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] planned to use the weapon in a plan to rebel against [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. [[EG-07]] a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] employed by Grievous located the weapon on Mustafar. By the time the Jedi Order had learned of Grievous's plans and tracked the weapon to Mustafar, Grievous had drilled down to the weapon and placed a [[Unidentified Mustafar battlesphere|battlesphere]] in Mustafar's atmosphere. Grievous planned to use the battlesphere's lasers to charge the weapon's long depleted power source.<ref name="Republic Heroes DS" /> 

In order to stop this, the Jedi dispatched [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] and [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] to disrupt the sphere's three firing platforms. After the first two platforms were successfully disabled, EG-07 confronted Skywalker and Tano at the third, delaying them long enough for the platform to fire and charge the weapon. The Jedi then delpoyed Jedi Masters [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] to the surface of the planet who each made their own ways down to the weapon. Once Windu made it to the weapons control center he engaged Grievous and eventually forced him to retreat. However before Grievous retreated he activated the weapon. Luckily for the Jedi, Windu's delay of Grievous gave Yoda the time to make it to the weapon's core which he was able to destroy which prevent the weapon from firing.<ref name="Republic Heroes DS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The superweapon was first shown in the [[Wikipedia:Nintendo DS|Nintendo DS]] edition of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Republic Heroes]]'' [[Star Wars video games|video game]], which was released in [[2009]].<ref name="Republic Heroes DS" />
